notes.notes:
This little patch aims to improve customizing the controls, both for the gamepad options and the keyboard. It it still far from perfect, but it's waaaay less of a confusing hassle of a nightmare now. 

I had suppressed how awful and none-intuitive these menus were - very sorry about it! Anyways: it should be better now. 

Best wishes and lots of love//Mattias

Very sorry about these inconveniences! As always: thank you for your patience, support, feedback and bug reporting.

notes.title: Patch 1.8.1.1
notes.notes:
- Fixes a bug which caused the game to crash at midnight in Honkertown.
- Gertrude now visits Honkertown everyday. I felt that there was no point having to wait and keeping count of every third day etc. (PS: the sign will still say "every third day" for old characters, but you can chop it down and a new correct one will reappear. You might notice that there are suuuper many signs at the same exact same position, that was something I discovered my self, and I have fixed that now. Enjoy all of those signs!)
- Dead players will no longer be poisoned again, sometimes resulting in another death after respawning.
- There won't be a crash when new characters interact with Moon Portals.

Best wishes and lots of love//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 1.8.1.0
notes.notes:
- The three latest armour were not visible on mannequins.
- 1.1 ice dagger were dropped, which was annoying and confusing. This will no longer happen.
- All coin values which are none integers (because of said bug) will be rounded up when you load a character.
- Correct sprite for the Grand Pyromancer mask when placed on mannequin.
- Correct minimap-position when in Area B5.
- Musketballs that are both piercing and have a special attack (like venom or reducing armour), will now do both.
- Amulet of Unending should no longer sometimes gradually decrease your total armour.
- A crash related to missing surfaces should now be gone also.
- You don't get the "Discovered lava" achievement when discovering ice.
- The game should no longer occasionally freeze when fighting sandworms.
- Two crashes related to fighting sandworms should no longer occur.
- Crashes related to the spider caves should no longer occur either.
- A few more fixes and some balancing.

Now, important: There might still be some unforseen issues with this patch because of a large update in the game engine I made this game in. If this happens to you - please let me know! In the mean time, the previously stable version can be reverted back to by right clicking on the game in your library, Properties -> Betas-> select "previously stable".

As always, thank you very much for all your feedback, kind words and fair critisism!
Lots of love and best wishes//Mattias

PS: I gave this patch a little higher priority than perhaps it deserves, but I figured I would reach more people this way so you guys know what's up.

notes.title: Patch 1.8.0.2
notes.notes:
Happy holidays everyone! This small patch means to fix a few things:
- The three latest armour were not visible on mannequins.
- 1.1 ice dagger were dropped, which was annoying and confusing. If you have ended up with a strange number of items or coins because of these, the easiest remedy is to manually chance your save files at -
C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Local\HollowIsland\Characters and then ini-file with the characters name.
- A few more fixes and some balancing.

EDIT: There seem be some unforseen performance issues + some minor bugs related to this patch, so this patch is currently optional. Right click on your game in your library -> Properties -> Betas and choose "latest - experimental". No password required.

I would greatly appreciated if a few people tried this out and gave me some feedback on how it runs. There was a rather big update in GameMaker, (where the game has been made), and switching to this version has caused some unexpected trouble, which I am currently trying to iron out.

Best wishes and lots of love//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 1.8 - Desert Island!
notes.notes:
Added:
- Three new areas: A4, A5 and B5. 
- A new biome with new enemies, terrain, weather (sandstorms) etc.
- 33 new items. To mention some of them: three armour sets, four legendary weapons, two new pets and a new minion-summoning item.
- Seven new enemies and one new boss.
- Four new achievements.
- Very rare and very valuable diamonds can now be found at all stages of the game when mining and when deconstructing stone blocks.
- There is also a new fish you can catch in calm fresh waters, like small ponds or Lake Everless. That fish might be a useful ingredient now. *hint*

Changed:
- You can now place buildings on terrain where you previously couldn't, like stone covered mountains.
- Oum, the priest NPC, now sells two legendary amulets which allows you to gain HP when dealing dot-damage: one for poison and one for fire.
- Eddrick also sells a legendary pickaxe.
- The GUI-effect when leeching life has been improved and makes more sense now I believe.
- The enviromental sounds in snow biomes has been changed to a more quite and colder-feeling one.

Fixed: 
- The spider cultists previously had a horrible sound when dealing melee damage, this has been fixed.
- Rain now has some variation instead of always falling straight down.
- The anti-freeze potion now lasts for 15 minutes instead of just 5.
- The game now saves all positive buffs applied to the player.
- Splash damage now affects ice elements. (There was an issue with the hitboxes before.)
- Flipping through crafting menus is now smoother and less flickery.

And I think that is it. As always I probably forgot to mention something and there might be some small bug that I have overlooked, so I will be ready for a hotfix should it be needed :)

Much love, best wishes and thanks for all your feedback, kinds words and support!
//Mattias

notes.title: Mini-fix! (Patch 1.7.0.1)
notes.notes:
Two fixes in this one:
- A crash related to ice elementals attacking wisps.
- I forgot to add my fishing-objects in the new area (A3) so if anyone fished in that ocean and didn't find anything, sorry, it has been fixed now!

Best wishes and lots of love//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 1.7 is out!
notes.notes:
This patch took a little longer than I suspected so sorry about that. The reason is I took a few weeks to work on my previous game, Grim Nights, and its DLC. There was some long-needed fixing that had to be done. So, without further ado:

Added:
- One new area: A3, with three new enemies and a boss.
- Two new NPC:s. One found in the new area, and the other being a new settler you can aquire by defeating the new boss. More info on the in-game pinboard in Honkertown.
- You can now expand your inventory with up to 10 slots. This costs 1 platina per slot and can be done in the new area. It might be tricky to get there, but you will manage with the new content. (HINT!)
- You can now build springboards and jump up on cliffs, take short cuts and discover some previously unaccessible places. (A note on this further down.)
- You can now sprint by holding down shift. So instead of dashing around when you are in a hurry, this is way more pleasant. 
- 13 new items, of which the most fun are: Four new legendary weapons sold by the new settler NPC.  (The springboards might actually be the most fun, but still) 
- Two new larger safes, for those really rich players out there.

Changed:
- You can now break down stone in the deconstructor, for a chance of gaining a few ores or gems.
- Every third in-game-day the game copies your characters world folder, just as a back up in case something totally unwanted happens.
- Summons are balanced for the better: The mecho ballistas have more HP and the wisps no longer harm player when exploding and they do much more damage.
- Carpenters table now have a "Misc" section where you find carpets, springboards, piggybank and mannequins.
- The close/loot/auto stack/etc buttons in containers now have a description.
- And some more very minor fixes and balances.

Fixed:
- Got rid of a few game-crashing event, one related to small spiderlings spawning and one related to destroying pots.
- Fixed a bug where ice-elementals also slowed you instead of "just" freezing you.
- Fixed a bug where enemies could still move when the game was paused.
- Got rid of some possible exploits related to storing items.

As always I probably forgot to mention something and perhaps I have overlooked some minor bug or annoyance so I will be ready for a hot fix should the need arise! 
Much love and many thanks for your support, kind words and feedback! If you haven't already, please leave a review, spread the word and help the game grow =)

Best wishes and happy Halloween!//Mattias

GIF: Springboards in action! Wow!

PS: Not all places which look "jumpable" are accessible. This is mainly because I build the game without every thinking about including jumping, so the level design sometimes must come first. But I have granted access to quite a few places which require springboards to reach, mainly cliffs which I thought neat and near places where people perhaps would like to expand their settlements, or just take shortcuts.

PPS: If you start a new game, there will be a rune-stone/shrine on a hill in Honkertown, so that is something that old characters will miss out on, sorry about that, I didn't find a smooth solution to adding it to already existing worlds.

notes.title: Patch 1.6 - Magic!
notes.notes:
TLDR:
This patch is packed with new content:
- Three new stats: mana, mana regeneration, and magic damage.
- Over 80 new items, armours, wands, staffs, etc, most of whom are related to magic.
- Two new areas: C3 and B3.
- Three new bosses and six new enemies.
- Access to the temple in Honkertown, with a new villagers there.
- One new type of dungeon.
- Mannequins + a few more furniture and crafting stations.
- One new building: mage tower.
- One new pet/animal: toads. Actually three different types can be found.
- One new farmable plant.
- An auto-sort inventory function.
- Four new achievements related to the new content.

A little more info:
- The walls in larger buildings have been increased so there is more room for decoration.
- A few small bugs and annoyances has been fixed, some prices has been adjusted.

This patch has been a while in the making and I must say I am very pleased with the content. It will be available for characters. Mana is gained by the shrines (just like the hp and stamina), but for old characters it will auto-level to the rest of your stats, so no worries. 

The temple will be open for all new characters, but for your old ones: You can get a key to open the temple from the pinboard in Honkertown.

As always I probably forgot to mention something, and there might be some unexpected bug so I will be very ready for a hot fix, but hopefully that won't be necessary! =)

Many thanks for all the feedback, the support and all your patience! If you want to support this game please share it with your friends and/or leave a review - it means the world to me!
Lots of love and best wishes!
//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 1.5.2
notes.notes:
There are two long needed features which I finally added with this patch:
- Auto stack into chests -> there will be a new button on top left of your chest slots.
- Plant + Harvest. If you have the corresponding seed equipped (Like chili seeds hovering over a chili plant) you will now plant a new crop while also harvesting the existing one. 

I also added some decorations:
- Paintings. Comes in three sizes and all can be purchased at Floras.
- More shovel-dec-options, like sand, flowers, tiny rocks and other details.

And I changed/fixed:
- Nerfed attack speed (Citrine) rings and amulets. 
- Greatly increased the distance in which harvested plants move towards you, making harvesting a lot easier.
- If you die while having turrets deployed they will be deactivated so you don't lose them.

I finally got some time to play my game myself again (it's been awhile since I really played it and not just tested the latest features) and I must say that I really enjoy it, hehe. But I noticed that the missing features above really annoyed me, so I took the time to get this done before I start the big work on the great and glorious 1.6 -magic-deluxe-patch.

As always: thanks for all the feedback, support and for playing my game!
Lots of love//Mattias

PS: I also added a hidden achievement =)

notes.title: Patch 1.5.0.1
notes.notes:
There where some sloppy mistakes made by yours truly. This hopefully fixes all of them =)
Thanks for the quick and thorough reporting and sorry for the inconvenience!

Best wishes//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 1.5 - Ancient Ruins
notes.notes:
TLDR:
Added:
- A new area, with new enemies, new challenges, new items and a new boss.
- Added stationary defensive units - mechanical ballistas.
- 18 new items, including: a new set of armor, steampunk nail rifle, melee weapon, throwable decrease armor potion, sword, and two new barrel types, which had been suggested/requested :)
- You can now delete characters, in the load game menu.
- Two new achievements.
- Deconstructing Table, which allows you to deconstruct items. 

Changed:
- You can now craft bedrolls, sacks, campfires and other useful items for any type of relevant resource.  (This was a great suggestion!) For example any type of hide can be used for bedrolls, the game will search for and select the cheapest one in your inventory.
- Mined sand and clay will spawn nearer you so won't waste time collecting it.
- You can now hear all villagers and settlers short intro-story again through a new dialogue option. Same with the pinboard and the old "looking to settle"-messages.
- Earth essence is way cheaper to buy. (12 gold instead of 80)
- The Clayshaper Potion (cursed earth) now also requires 7 tomb shrooms to craft. This is to limit farming that boss which was to easy and profitable. 
- Both blunderbuses, Teags baby and the old one, have longer reloading time. They where a little too good.
- When buying and crafting new items you will be notified when your inventory is full.
- Crafting barrels will now give you three each time, so they are actually useful - cheap but take up much space.

Fixed:
- Auto-resizing should work well with larger monitors as well. (Finally!)
- Sleeping in a cave/dungeon will no longer cause you to wake in near total darkness.
- When changing graphic settings there will be a smooth fade instead of an annoying blink.

A little more info:
I probably added/changed/fixed some more stuff, but I believe these are the most important ones. I really hope you enjoy this patch - it is the first handcrafted big dungeon in the game. I hope it works out - let me know what you think!

As always, many thanks for your support, feedback, ideas and suggestion - they mean the world to me and to the game! <3 
If you enjoy Hollow Island, please leave a review to give the game as chance to reach more people!

Lots of love and best wishess//
Mattias

PS: Next patch might take a little longer: I want to add three new areas and introduce magic to the game. Magic would be available almost from the beginning, so at least two of the new areas will be rather early game difficulty, but I will be sure to add some fun stuff for end game players as well! 
Also, I will take a vacation soon and be a little harder to reach the nearest weeks, just so you know! =)

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
TLDR:
- Four new NPCs: Three settlers and one who visits Honkertown every third day and sells animals.
- Mines. You can now build mines which basically gives you endless dungeons if you so wish. 
- New mini-area. You can now find very small but sometimes very rich mini-areas in certain dungeons, basically ore or coal veins.
- Farm animals: hens and chicken.
- Gates, mainly for controlling your farm animals.
- New grand building - two story brick house.
- Improved ranged combat. You can now load while moving and fire right away once loaded, allowing for way more fun and quick paced ranged combat.
- Carpets, allowing for interior decoration. Works like the shovel.
- Stone cairns, allowing you to mark locations on your mini map. 
- Brew wine to make money.
- All 99 stacks are now raised to 100, and 499 to 500. Glass is raised to 500 instead of 99.
- Caro sells copper, iron and steel bars.
- You now start where you log out.  I tried playing it this way and found it way better. You can quick your game and pick up where you left, teleport potions are much more valuable and you can no longer restart-to-go-home-exploit, which I often had to resist myself.
- Quality of life equip: Shift clicking on an item in your inventory will now move it to the first empty belt slot (1-10). 
- Removal of terrain obstacles. You can now craft a Fireacid potion, which allows you to remove rough terrain, like boulders, holes and dead trees. This is mainly to allow you to expand your settlement, not to to open new passage between areas.
- In total 28 new items added, many listed above.
- Five new achievements.
- Minor additions and improvements.

Some additional info:
This patch mainly aims to improve the quality of the non-mining/non-adventuring aspects of the game. You will be able to make more money through your settlement and the new NPC:s will sell many of resources which might be tedious to always go on a hunt for. You can buy animals from Gertrude, an NPC which will arrive every third day at the docks in Honkertown. There will be a sign there telling you this. 

The ranged combat system is now way more fun, if I may say so. You will now notice an icon under the player which shows if your weapon is loaded or not, and you will see the reload progress as long as your attack is ranged one.  Since you now reload even when moving, you can kite enemies and quickly hip fire. 

As always, thank you so very much for your support and feedback, I really hope you enjoy this patch =)
Next big patch will be one area: A1, but it will be one big dungeon and very dangerous dungeon which I think will be really fun to explore with a lot of cool new gears and weapons.

Best wishes//Mattias

PS: A special thanks to Pernilla and Tobias for their great feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0.1 - One little fix
notes.notes:
The latest patch came with a possible bug where some of the NPC:s could apparently disappear, never to return. I am very sorry about this, and this little hot fix will have fixed that. You will be able to continuing playing as usual - the missing villagers will have returned.

Best wishes//Mattias

PS: Super funny trivia: They were not really missing, they "just" spawned at the top left corner of the area where they where impossible to find.

notes.title: Patch 1.3 - Settlements and bare lands
notes.notes:
TLDR:
Probably the biggest patch so far, it includes:
- Three new areas, A2, B1 and B2. (Accessed through C2)
- 26 new items, including 2 new armour sets and new types of ranged weapons: muskets.
- Six new enemies.
- One new boss.
- New feature: starting settlements.
- Two new NPCs, whom may join your settlement.
- Three new achievments.
- Being able to change hair, beard and hair colour in game. (Through one of the settlers)
- Some bug fixes and overall improvements.
- The hours which count as day has also been expanded, so day time is two hours longer.

The longer version:
This patch took longer than I thought, so sorry to have kept you waiting. I wanted the new features to really add something to the game and maintain the feeling of still discovering stuff, so it took a while to figure out and balance the new items. Also I wanted the settlement-mechanics to be stable and pleasant enough and hopefully I have achieved that, hehe. =)

So you can now claim a settlement through your peace shrine. There is a pinboard in Honkertown which gives you info on what you need for the settlers to arrive. All plantable food also displays the amount of food value they will add to your settlement once fully grown, and living- and storage area-items (houses, cellars) will display how much they increase the settlements population capacity. You can only have two settlers right now but the next patch will add at least three more (Next patch will be a decorations-cosystuff-buildings-npcs-patch).

I also noted that some of the light effects had lost quality (no gradient basically) when I added the brightness/contrast/saturation-shader, so I have now fixed that. Also the venom scales armour is no longer built from the strong smithy but instead from a better tanning station. Also, once you have defeated the Clayshaper Kline will sell more and better bolts. 

There is problary more stuff that I just can't think of right now, but these are the big parts. As always: your support is greatly appreciated! =)

Much love//Mattias

PS: If you enjoy the game, please leave a review, they mean everything for indie developers like me! And if you don't enjoy the game you can also leave a review, but please keep it constructive so I can learn and become better at my job! =)

notes.title: Patch 1.2.2.1
notes.notes:
What has been fixed/changed:
- Changed the apperance of the interface left-right arrows, since several people didn't notice them in the crafting menus, so hopefully they will pop out more now.
- Fixed a bug related to the loot-all-button.
- Barrels will no longer spawn on top of each other in the dungeons in D3. This hopefully also got rid of the "cursed coal" bug.
- The Use/Interact key has been changed so it registers the release instead of the push. This is to avoid annoying things like accidentaly picking your precious potato plants by accident when closing a chest. (Maybe this only happened to me, but I did it all the time myself and got really annoyed, hehe)
- There is a GUI-message when the game autosaves, so if you get a small stutter, you will know why.

Well, that's it for this small patch. Thanks a lot for the feedback and all the support! I'm working on 1.3, which will include three new areas: B2, B1 and A2. This will be big patch and even though I've got a lot of work done, there is still much more to do so hang in there!

In the meantime: best wishes and stay safe everybody! =)
//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.notes:
What's been fixed:
- Got rid of a strange drawing-error at the edges of a few dungeons.
- Got rid of a several issues related to pausing, like: health and stamina regenerated, some traps could still be triggered, sand troglodytes (yes, that's what I call those enemies outside the mausoleum) still spawned, titanium armour could still damage enemies.

What's been changed:
- Damage- and GUI message pop-ups are now drawn over the darkness layer so they will always be readable.
- The lower part of living areas are now transparent, so you can fully use all your hard earned space!
- Every time you enter a new area you will be helped to a free spot, so you won't get stuck in furniture you've might have place there. 

Thanks a lot for reporting bugs and inconviences to me - it makes it so much easier to improve the gaming experience for everyone! =)

Best wishes//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1.1
notes.notes:
TLDR:
- Improved screen resolution stuff. (This is not 100% fixed still, sorry, but it is better than it used to be)
- Hopefully got rid of the fatal error that happens sometimes when defeating the basilisk.
- To make steel ingots you know use iron ingots instead of ore.

There are still some issues if your monitor is large than 1920x1080, but this patch makes it better somewhat - if you select 1920x1080 and go full screen the game and the gui will scale properly, cover the screen and the game should work as intended. I am still working on a better solution but I figured I release so you have the best-so-far-version.

I am still not sure exactly what causes the basilisk-error but I might have solved it for now. *fingers crossed*

Also, I found it rather annoying myself to save a bunch of iron ore to perhaps make steel later on in the game, and I just had a ton of iron ingots that never came to use, so I think this solution is better.

Best wishes//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.notes:
TLDR:
- Added a mutated chili plant which only drops fire glands.
- Improved the grass and dirt tiles.
- Improved the mainscreen logo.

The longer version:
Well, this is a very minor patch but I wanted to release it anway. It mainly improved the looks of the game somewhat, which I wanted because I added new screenshots from this version. Now there is also a small chance (1 /20) that your chili plants drop mutated chili seeds, which always and only drops several fire glands. The never drop more than one seed however, so you can only gain plants by the original non-mutated chili plants.

But perhaps most importantly, if you are reading this and haven't bought the game: wait until tomorrow! I will have a big sale that starts tomorrow, 50% off for 5 days!

If you already own this game and would like to recommend it to friends, now might be a good time =) It would indeed be very appreciated!

As always: a very big thanks to everyone whom bought the game, your kinds words, feedback and support means the world to me!

Best wishes//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is out
notes.notes:
TLDR:
- Over 20 new items: New fishing rods, fishes, meals and potions.
- A new villager in Honkertown, a fisherman named Burnt-Face Jake.
- Kline can offer some useful info about mining.
- Improved gamepad controls.
- 3 new achievements.

The longer version:
The patch mainly focuses on fishing. It is a feature I very much enjoy myself in similar games and it has been requested by several people, so I really hope you enjoy it =) It comes with three achievements related to fishing. The new villager is found along the coast in D5, Honkertown.

I also got some feedback on the gamepad controls so I have updated those and I think they are better this way. When mining, chopping wood and using melee weapons you will no longer have to rely on the cursor to aim - you will instead strike/mine in the direction you are looking, removing the need to use the right stick all the time. Aiming with crossbow, throwing dynamites, etc, will still require the use of the right stick.

Next big patch will add new areas, but there might be a smaller patch in between!

Best wishes//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.notes:
- There were some issues with screen resolution and the character not being centered on screen, this minor patch hopefully fixes that: Auto-resizing from options, should do the trick! (Very sorry for the inconvenience!)
- Auto-Resize should work the way it was intended.
- Switching between fullscreen and windowed will no longer move the game window outside the display.
- It also adds more places to get Everless Water: basically there are spots along all streams that connects to the lake.
- The damage-info of the Gilded Crossbow was wrong, so that is fixed.

This is just sort of a hot-fix patch, what I have been working on mainly is fishing, and that patch is almost done, so please stay tuned =)

Also: Many thanks for reporting issues so I get a chance to improve the game!

Best wishes//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.notes:
TLDR:
- Added graphic options: Brightness, Contrast, Saturation.
- Fixed a few bugs.
- Changed the default colour palette.
- Changed the default contrast to be slightly higher.

The longer version:
I saw some comments about the colours being to bland and I added a shader to the game and experimentent and I have to say I agree and the new default is a little crisper but way better! You can go bananas with the sliders and play in a over-contrasted black and white world if you'd like! 

I also changed the default filling-colour to a nice, calm foresty-green, which I think is way prettier! It will be applied automatically if it's the first time you play, otherwise just click 'Reset' and it will be applied that way =)

If you used the Hearth Brew (the potion that makes you immune to being frozen) the game crashed, really sorry about this! There where a few minor fixes as well, at least I think so, but I forgot to write them down, but these were the bigger ones!

As always: Many many thanks for all your feedback and support - it means the world to me!

Best wishes//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is out!
notes.notes:
TLDR:
Added the follwing:
- 2 new areas: C2 and C1. 
- 2 new dungeon types.
- 40 new items - including 3 new armour sets.
- 6 new enemies.
- 1 new boss.
- 1 new achievement.

Longer version:
So, 1.1 if finally out. It took about a week longer than I had planned. I lost about a weeks worth of work being sick and I had also over worked both my wrists, so I needed some time to recover from that. This patch is the first bigger one and there will be several more in the up coming months :) 

The entrance to the new areas can be find in D2, where Kline had put up sign - that path is finally cleared! These new areas and dungeons are the most dangerous so far, so be prepared!  
All this content is rather linear from 1.0, so to speak. The next patch take a different path - it will add a new and requested feature: fishing! So stay tuned for that =)

Best wishes//Mattias

notes.title: Patch 1.05 - Controller support!
notes.notes:
TLDR:
- Controller support!
- Minor fixes.

Longer version
- Added  controller support and you can customize the bindings somewhat. I am not much of a controller-gamer myself, so any and all feedback is appreciated!
- You can now change keyboard- and controllers bindings so one key has multiple uses. For example 'C' can open both Inventory and Character (which has been requested).
- Added a "Loot all"-button to containers.
- Fire elementals can now walk over lava, making the lava dungeons more challening + it makes more sense.
- Poison rats now only deal one dot-damage at a time.
- Removed an annoying bug/feature where you could not strike if the cursors was near an entrance,
- You can no longer steal the street lights in Honkertown.
- You can now quick-close the fireplace with F (default key), same as all other work stations.

The controller support is of course the big update in this patch. You should be able to play the game to 99% with only a controller, but you will have to use the keyboard to enter your write stuff, like the characters name and rename chests. The tutorial is updated so if you play with a controller it will give you relevant instructions. It may take some time getting used to (If you have ideas how to improve, please let me know!) but I made it this way not to lose any features, like being able to strike in one direction and abort by dashing the opposite direction.

As always: Thanks so very much for buying my game and all the support and great feedback I have received so far =)

Best wishes//Mattias

PS: The next patch (1.1) should be ready in roughly two weeks. It will feature two new areas with new dungeons, three more armor sets, one new boss, three or four new enemies and in total maybe 30-40 new items =)

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
- Removed a bug which gave you unlimited food.
- Added numbers to the hotkey inventory slots, 1-0.
- Better crafting system - all ingredients no longer need to be in the same stack to count as enough. 
- The well can no longer the placed indoors. 
- Removed a bug where the Clayshaper-potion could destroy a wall.

Also: I added a new mustasch, a scarred eye brow and a sidecut hairstyle availabe for new characters. 

PS: I am looking into adding controller support and the progress for the bigger update is going just fine. It might take 3-4 weeks more but it should give  a few hours more content even if you play very fast, at least that's the idea =)

Best wishes//Mattias

notes.title: Release tomorrow!
notes.notes:
TLDR: 
Hollow Island will be updated rapidly - more areas to explore, new items, enemies, features etc. etc. It will all be part of the original game, not DLC:s. 
My previous game Grim Nights had a terrible save system - Hollow Island has a waaaaay better system, build to last. 

The longer version:
In less than 24 hours the game will be released - I am super excited and of course rather nervous. I and many beta testers (huge thanks to all of you! <3) have played the game for many hours now, and I have tried my best to get rid of all bugs and make the game as smooth of an experience as possible. 
My old game Grim Nights used a built in save-game-feature which was the opposite of dynamic - it ruined all save files everything I patched the game (still very sorry about that!). So for my new game I made my own save system, which will allow you to keep your saves through   any patch that I can imagine. I just wanted to inform you, in case you played my old game and was worried that I learnt nothing from my mistakes =)

In version 1.0 (the current one), you will have access to 11 large land areas - all have something unique about them, along with their own dungeons and caves to explore. There are almost 300 items to craft and/or discover, over 20 enemies and 3 bosses, and many features to enjoy. However: These numbers will grow rapidly with future patches. My plan is to release a semi-big patch every month as long as I feel I have more to offer. As of now, the beta testers playtime varied heavily (from 2-3 hours up to over 30 hours), just to give you some clue of what to expect =)

Anyways, thank you for taking your time to read this - I am looking forward to your reviews, hearing your experiences, seeing your screenshots and videos, and all constructive feedback! 
I very, very much hope you enjoy my game!

Best wishes//Mattias
